gui.text: Digite '/?' ou '/help' no chat para ver uma lista de comandos.
You stumbled into a party in a Dirty Apartment...
- Click on other people to interact with them.
- Leave now if you are not 18 years old or older.
- No bullying or harassing  other people.
The creator of the game just joined the party!
/afk - let others know you are afk
/tp [player] - teleport to any player in server
/refresh - refresh your character without losing your items or position
/flex - shows in chat how much robux you sent and events you created.
- Click on other players to interact with them.
(You can laugh with a person or buy a friend a drink for example.)
- Grab yourself a drink and hit the dance floor.
(drinks are scattered around, and you should own some emotes for dancing.)
- Check out all the areas, its more than meets the eye.
(example the balcony has a secret location, and have you seen the laundry room?)
